title: Traffic Stop
short_description: 2017 documentary film by Kate Davis and David Heilbroner

text.lead: Traffic Stop is a 2017 American documentary film directed by Kate Davis and David Heilbroner.
text.plot: It chronicles a white police officer's stop and, ultimately, arrest of Breaion King, a 26-year-old African-American school teacher from Austin, Texas.

sections.Lead: Traffic Stop is a 2017 American documentary film directed by Kate Davis and David Heilbroner.
sections.Summary: It chronicles a white police officer's stop and, ultimately, arrest of Breaion King, a 26-year-old African-American school teacher from Austin, Texas.
sections.Accolades: The film was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Documentary Short Subject at the 90th Academy Awards. After airing on HBO, it was nominated for an Emmy for Outstanding Short Documentary at the 40th News and Documentary Emmy Award. It received generally positive reviews from critics.
